one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent achieved a near-optimal feasible solution but consistently saved it to .npy files (solution.npy, solution_improved.npy, final_solution.npy, best_solution.npy) instead of the required /app/solution.txt, never correcting this and claiming success at step 30.
t_err_evidence: At step 24, after running projected gradient descent, the agent calls np.save('/app/solution.npy', x_opt) instead of np.savetxt('/app/solution.txt', x_opt), establishing the wrong artifact path from the first save.
t_commit_evidence: At step 24, the agent saves to /app/solution.npy and subsequent steps (25-28) continue refining from .npy artifacts and saving to new .npy files (solution_improved.npy, final_solution.npy, best_solution.npy), never introducing a .txt save.
trigger_explanation: The task specification required saving the solution to /app/solution.txt, but the agent used np.save() (binary .npy format) throughout without ever reading or verifying the output format requirement. The agent never checked what format the grader expected and defaulted to NumPy's native binary format.
